t: Go to the coast opposite Draconid Island. Use the Magic Decoy to lure the Draconids and take their blood and heart. Use the communication device on the entrance to the cave to send these samples to the Wormfaces.

I have one more request before we part. I'm not sure you'll like it. I mean, I'm almost sure that you won't like it.
You will have to kill. You'll have to kill Draconids. It is a dirty job, I know, but it needs to be done. Believe me, you will get a proper reward!
We'll give you a Magic Decoy. Only Draconids can hear its sound and they cannot resist it.
The Overmind has asked for Draconid Heart and Draconid Blood. Don't ask what we need them for. The explanation would take a lot of time and I'm not sure that you'd understand at least one-third of what we tell you. Just do it for our lost magnificence, which burned to ashes in flames brought upon our race by the Great Dragons!
I realize you might not enjoy this task... But I promise you will be rewarded!

Draconid blood and heart. This is exactly what I need! We are very grateful to you.
Concerning the reward... We know that you've been looking for shards of the crystal armor of the last June known to you as Zak. We know where you can find this shard.
But we don't want to reveal our knowledge. We gave the knowledge of the location of this shard away to one of those pompous Historians. Let them think that they found the shard... even though we know you deserve it.
Let the Darkness keep you! We believe that you will use this shard wisely.
Use the Talk-back Device to talk to the representative of the Wormfaces.

The Wormfaces are a very ancient race. They are not as ancient as we, the Elves, but their history dates back to the ages of the Junes! Can you imagine that? They could have told us a lot about Sarnaut's past. However, there is one problem... It is not even a problem, it is a dead-end! The Wormfaces refuse to talk to us!
They've locked themselves under the ground and won't come out. Yes, I understand that they cannot stand bright light and open space, but since we are allies they could have invited me to come in! But they didn't! I have to stand in front of their door and talk to them using an Talk-back Device. But my partner in conversation... I am the Ambassador Plenipotentiary of the Historians whose studies may change the future of the world! But my partner in conversation is... a servant! A plebeian! Oh, great powers of Sarnaut! Sometimes I don't want to act like a scientist, but to act as a stupid militant and to explode the dungeon with all of its arrogant inhabitants.
They could have shared precious June knowledge, their magic and technology... But they are too stubborn to talk!
Please, establish contact with the Wormfaces. I have a feeling that you will have more luck than me. The Talk-back Device is next to the entrance to their dungeon.
Two hundred twenty four... I'm so tired of you...
Return to the Ambassador of the Historians Maurice de Vevre and convey to him the words of the Seventeenth.

Greetings to you, the two hundred and twenty fourth Seeker of, ahem, "Truth".
The Overmind welcomes you and so do I, the Overmind's humble worker, the Seventeenth Observer.
As I already said two hundred twenty three times before, we, the Overmind, are not inclined to believe anything that newcomers from the ground say. We are also not going to tell you anything until you prove your benevolent intentions.
You, fussy creatures from the ground, will never understand what pleasure deep and slow contemplation gives. You will never understand the beauty of the idea which slowly grows in the depths of your mind for decades.
Do you really think that those who live for a moment between birth and death can interest us in any way? Well, you can try.
If you prove that you deserve our attention we will help you in your research. But now, as you seem useless to us, we won't help you.
Convey my words to the pompous Elf who calls himself the "Historian". We are tired of his humble attempts to discover inexistent secrets of the Junes from us!
So, have the Wormfaces told you anything?

Exactly! This is exactly what I was talking about! Their behavior is absolutely indecent when someone is trying to reveal white spots in the history of Sarnaut. Damned snobs! What should we do? I think we should somehow convince these swelled heads that we are on their side...
My monograph will be incomplete without a practical basis for my theoretical speculations. I need the Golem Fragments. Hurry up!

Thank you. You deserve my sincere appreciation and the acceptance of all Wormfaces!
Now, finally, I can complete my great historical work...
Go to Avilon, take the Bag of June Trinkets from Luc de Blizare and bring them to the Wormfaces' cave entrance.

Wow! It seems to me that the ice is broken... I knew that you could cope with the challenge and break the wall which our "charming" allies built to hide from us.

Before you came, there were hundreds of adventurers like you who tried to talk to them through the Talk-back Device. But none of them received a task other than to kill the Undead or to collect samples from poor Crawlers. Then along you come... and you receive a task not about biology which, I must confess, is not my forte, but about history. Well, I know more about history than anyone else! I am a Historian!

So, the Wormfaces are interested in June artifacts... Hmm, what do they need them for?

Let me think. I also have a little errand for you. Go to Avilon to our base camp and meet the Archivist. I wrote him a letter, so he will give you all the June trinkets our association happened to find. There are various beads, color glass, shards... We don't need that crap.

Let's offer the Wormfaces these trinkets and see what their reaction is.
I have already sent the letter to Luc. Your parcel is waiting for you.
Huh? ... What the crap? Some stones, beads... Do we look like butt-naked cavemen?
Sometimes you have to forget about your past to save your future... Remember these words!

Well well... I already know that you helped us to get rid of one more fragment of our sad past. You must be interested in why we are so eager to get rid of our legacy. I'm sorry but I can't explain it to you right now.
However you've earned our pardon and your reward. I think you can still be helpful, the one who lives above!
Go to the Hissing Canyon and meet Gennady Helmov, the Historian Ambassador's Assistant.

I... I can't believe my ears! These creatures are destroying memories! They're actually erasing their past! Barbarians! They are so happy doing this that they are ready to reward you for helping...
No, there must be something wrong. Maybe I'm mistaken but it seemed to me that I felt hidden sadness in the voice of the Wormface who talked to you.
I don't trust that Tenth. I think he didn't approve of that order. But he had to issue it to conceal... To conceal what? That is the question. And also the problem. We know too little about our mysterious allies...
Listen, I have an idea. Let's try to provoke a reaction from the Wormfaces.
Not far from here, in Hissing Canyon, my colleagues found an almost completely intact statue of one of the Junes' greatest Hunters tearing the jaws of the Great Dragon. At least, we think that this statue depicts that event...
We'll use this statue in our gambit! But the statue needs to be delivered here.
Go to the Hissing Canyon and talk to Gennady Helmov, my Assistant. Help him to deliver the statue there.
Hey, be careful! Don't trample on the shards! They are of high historic value. Though, not every shard... The one to the right looks more like a piece of packaging from our breakfast...
Here you are! We've been waiting for you. Maurice speaks highly of you. He is sure that with your help we will solve all the mysteries surrounding those weird Wormfaces.
Make sure the yak is ready. If it is absent, wait for it to come back.

So, we have loaded the statue and fastened it. Your task is to guard the statue during transportation. Not one single crack should appear on this magnificent masterpiece of June sculpture... Oh, it is a priceless rarity!
Well, we are ready. Let's check the yak. You'd better do it yourself, since you are to guard it on the road to the Catacombs.
Looks like the yak is ready for the journey!
Follow the yak transporting the statue to the entrance to Catacombs.
But where is the cargo you are to guard?

Oh... The statue is magnificent! A true exquisite masterpiece... Nothing today surpasses the Junes' stone carving art! It's a pity that such beauty will be destroyed... But what can I do... History needs sacrifices.
Pass on the words of Maurice de Vevre via the Talk-back Device.

Well, it's time to tell you my plan.
Look, despite what Tenth told you, they didn’t throw away our package after all. Which means it's not complete garbage. As for the destroyed steles... They might have decided to sacrifice what they could to keep their secret.
But this statue... Oh, it's beautiful! And I intend to burn it before their very eyes! The hot clay will crack, and the statue will turn into a pile of sand!
No, of course I'm not going to burn anything. I'm bluffing - there's no way I'd be able to damage this masterpiece. But the Wormfaces don't know about this!
If there really is a connection between the ancient Junes and the current Wormfaces, if they actually collect ancient June relics, they will never allow us to destroy this statue and will try to stop us. Which means they have to take off the mask and show their true face! Do you understand what I mean?
Go tell this Tenth, Seventeenth, or whoever is on the other side of the door, that we have the most beautiful ancient June statue in our possession. But since they don't care about their past, we're going to destroy it!
Why did you bring this sordidness to the threshold of our home? Take it back. I told you that we are not interested in the Junes' old crap!
Wha-a-at? Do you want to burn this statue in front of us? You are welcome. We are not interested in old crap.
Meet Gorislav Gipitsky at the Crossroads.

I, Gorislav Gipitsky, or the director of the greatest play in the world to be more precise, chose a guise of an innkeeper, and am now looking for new actors to take part in my grandiose play. The reward for participating is revelation - true revelation in which you will discover the truth about the past and in which you can also see the future of this world!
Where is the letter? Was it delivered in time?

Well, hello, if you really mean it... I see you are intrigued by my letter, right? I had no doubts.
So, you are tired of being a wooden chip carried away by wild waters of history. Do you want to ride the waves? Do you want to make your destiny instead of following the preset order? Great! That is the answer I was expecting. Otherwise I wouldn't have invited you.
Now listen to me carefully.

You can still call me Gorislav, as you used to. Or if you wish, call me Director.
As for my true name... The answer will come in time. The Time will call my name!

You see, a certain event occurred about a century ago that put at risk all our current attempts to withstand both demons and the Power that controls them. If we change the Past, our present lives will be so much easier!
Besides, we'd better deliver a strike when our enemy least expects it. Sarn is not prepared now. I think this is a great opportunity!
h: Ask about the need to change the Past

t:
In the middle of the Crossroads there is a Whirlpool of Time - a vortex where the Past that came to be, the unstable Present, and the variable Future are swirling.
The Whirlpool of Time is dangerous. An unexperienced time traveler would rather drown themselves than appear in the right place at the right time. But don't worry - I will teach you everything you need to know.
Still, we require something else but your bravery and my powers. Time is always hungry for blood, but we can deceive it.
h: Ask about travels into the Past

t:
The Ashes of the Past! The Time would prefer to devour this magic substance over you. Every time you travel to the Past, you have to feed Time with this delicacy.
You can find the Ashes of the Past on an Isle called the Astral Graveyard.

The main change you triggered is that the great battle between the League and the Empire has ceased to be! The Expeditionary Corps and The Regiment of Kirah never engaged into the bloodshed, they came prepared for the demon assault.
Of course, demons pummeled both armies, but not as severely as they used to.
As a result, demons had to change their tactics. But more on that later...
Your actions had other consequences as well. Yasker, for one, became terrified of zombies and decided to study necromancy deeper. So we are not sure of the outcome of his battle against Eniel.
On the other hand, having witnessed the resurrection, Negus Tot did not put much trust in science and confided in religion instead. Nobody knows yet what it means for us.
The mysterious demon you encountered was an assassin whose only goal was killing you. Our enemy knows that we want to change the Past, and he made his move.
h: Ask about the threats from the Future

t: As you may guess, we shall not lay our arms down. There is something we should change in the Past. It is no less important than the prevention of war or the salvation of Kirah. We will do it, and no assassins will stop us!

If you have read the chronicles of the past, you might remember what they say about demon intrusion to Kirah. Let me cite it for you...
"First fell the tower of Vlad, the Great Xadaganian Mage..."
Can you see any towers here?
There is none. Vlad is here, but no tower around. Why? Because Vlad has never been a Great Mage!
h: Ask about the Mystery of the Mages

t: Read the letter from Gorislav in your mailbox and meet him at the Crossroads.

Hey! Hang on... Yes, sure, there is a letter waiting for you. An urgent one! It was delivered by hand recently, and they asked that it be hand delivered and that I make sure that it reaches it's addressee. You are the addressee, so the letter in the box is waiting for you. Our postal service works like clockwork!
So, is it time for some new discoveries, eh?
I can see you received my letter. You don't get it, do you? It's okay, we can fix it in no time. Listen to me now.
A woman should lie in bed, a corpse should lie in a grave!

Oh, you smell like hell... Why did you tear the Undead into small pieces? Sneak up from behind, hit them once on the head and they will be buried in their grave again to rest in peace. Don't worry: experience must be earned.
Well, thank you, buddy. I don't know what I would do without you! Here is your reward. If you want more easy money, come visit me from time to time. Don't be shy! I'm always happy to see old friends again.
Confirm that you understood what was said by talking to the Master's Voice.

You are one of those destined to receive the revelation. Me and my brethren are here to help you complete this task. This is Master's Wish.
I will tell you what should be done.
The real Tka-Rik Revelation is kept in the June Mage's Cave to the east of here. The Cave is sealed with a magic barrier which can be penetrated only by someone protected by Crystal Armor. That Armor helped Ath-Zak, the ancient hero, to defeat the June Curse.
Your task right now is to find the shards of Crystal Armor and to reforge it. This is the Master's Wish.
Do you accept it?
So, what do you think? Deal?

Great.
It is very wise of you to follow the Master's wishes. I've been doing it for thousands of years and don't regret it.
Confirm that you understood what was said by talking to the Master's Voice.

You are one of those destined to receive the revelation. Me and my brethren are here to help you complete this task. This is Master's Wish.
I will tell you what should be done.
The real Tka-Rik Revelation is kept in the June Mage's Cave to the east of here. The Cave is sealed with a magic barrier which can be penetrated only by someone protected by Crystal Armor. That Armor helped Ath-Zak, the ancient hero, to defeat the June Curse.
Your task right now is to find the shards of Crystal Armor and to reforge it. This is the Master's Wish.
Do you accept it?
So, what do you think? Deal?

Great.
It is very wise of you to follow the Master's wishes. I've been doing it for thousands of years and don't regret it.
Complete the trial of the five Guards by overcoming your vices and bringing the Armor Shard you receive to the Master's Voice in the Citadel.

The fact that you listen to the Master's words and want to know the Truth is good. Not everyone is allowed to understand the revelation. I've seen hundreds and thousands of strong and confident creatures who thought that the world lied at their feet, but they all died one step away from their goal. Why? Because it is in the nature of sentient beings to neglect their weaknesses, to justify their vices and to underestimate their hidden fears.
The Master wants to try you. You will have to face your vices and fears and defeat them. If your body and spirit are strong, without sin or vices, you will achieve true magnificence.
Around the Citadel you will find five Guards. They all want to try you, to make you face your weaknesses. If you can overcome them, you will make one more step towards the revelation.
If you complete the task you will receive a shard of Zak's crystal armor. Bring it to me and I will keep it until you have collected all the shards and are ready to reforge the armor.
Go now and remember: small weak spots can cause huge troubles.
Battling against your vices is a tough battle as you are fighting against yourself!

I knew that you would succeed! The Master is never wrong and he doesn't need to test you.
This trial was for you all along...
Find the World Explorer in the ruins of the Granite Madness and take Zak's Crystal Armor Shard. Bring it to the Master's Voice in the Citadel.

Your loyalty to the Master is doubtless. You perceive his wisdom and want to receive the revelation. Such striving to understand mysteries is rare for inhabitants of this world, who prefer to have fun and not to think about coming disasters.
You already possess a few Crystal Armor Shards. One of our explorers, World Explorer, happened to find another Shard! I can say that you've completed more than a half of your journey to the revelation.
But there is one problem. Our explorers are engaged in battle with the Undead in the ruins and cannot deliver the shard to the Citadel. You must help them out.
Go to the ruins of the Granite Madness, find our explorer, take the shard and deliver it to me. It will be safe here in the Citadel until you have collected all seven shards. Then we'll reforge the armor and you will enter Tka-Rik's Cave and receive the so long-awaited revelation!
Have you found the World Explorer? How is he doing?

Look how beautifully the edges of this gem sparkle in the sun... It's fascinating. Now try to imagine how the whole armor would have sparkled and how skillful June artisans created such masterpiece. The Junes were great masters... They died because of Sarn's anger.
But soon his evil reign will come to end. Very soon the Master will discharge his anger upon him and Sarn will be defeated. Peace will come to Sarnaut and you will be its harbinger!
Use the Searching Stick to explore the swamp at Rusty Saltings. Find the huge Hydra and retrieve the Crystal Armor Shard. Bring it to the Master's Voice in the Citadel.

Agr-r-r... You friend and brother! Me know. You want shiny thing. Sharp thing.
We had such thing. Mage wore thing on neck. Wore it long and long.
Hydra eat the mage! Big Hydra! Chew-chew the mage! With the thing chew-chew!
Now the thing in the belly. In big Hydra. Hydra sleep in swamp. Under water and sleep!
Me give you stick. Searching stick. You take the stick. You poke with the stick. Search Hydra!
Hydra come out, you kill Hydra! And chew-chew!
Thing inside Hydra. Thing not eat! Thing wear. Shiny thing...
What news do you have... good or bad?

One more Crystal Armor Shard! Excellent!
You are one step closer to the true revelation now. As soon as you have found all seven shards and brought them to me I will try to reforge the armor. Then you will be able to enter Tka-Rik's Cave and will learn the truth about the past, present and future.
Use Treasure Seeker's Kit to find the buried chest in the Hissing Canyon. Dig it out and take the Crystal Armor Shard. Give it to the Master's Voice in the Citadel.

Recently we learned something very exciting. Scorched remains of some rascals were found in the Hissing Canyon. They were lucky enough to have found one of Zak's Crystal Armor Shards! It is a very precious artifact. I would even say that it's priceless!
They buried the treasure but didn't make it very far. They started to fight and killed each other. Now they are decomposing but give a good example of what can happen if you don't control your desire for money...
So, back to the shard. I'm offering you the chance to try to find it. You can use the special Treasure Seeker's Kit.
When you near the chest, the Scanner will produce a beeping sound. Take the shovel and start digging! If you find a chest and not a rusty piece of plough, then you've probably found the Shard!
I heard the Historians told you about some mysterious treasure... Have you found it?

One more Crystal Armor Shard! Excellent!
You are one step closer to the true revelation now. As soon as you have found all seven shards and brought them to me I will try to reforge the armor. Then you will be able to enter Tka-Rik's Cave and will learn the truth about the past, present and future.

You brother and friend! You strong? Me not believe.
You show you strong! You go to swamp. Hit Hydra. Three handfuls Hydras!
When you kill three handfuls of Hydra come back. Then me believe!
Hydra strong! If you strong you kill hydra. If you weak hydra eat you! Chew!

Now I believe. You strong!
Me respect you!

Are the zombies really dead? Well done.
Unfortunately, as your saying goes: "Nature abhors a vacuum", and soon new Deadmen will get out of their graves.
But nevertheless, you deserve this reward. You can be proud of yourself!
Participate in killing the Lizardman Shaman and talk to George Siverian.

Hey, do you want to earn some money? Then listen to me.
The leader of those tiny creatures with hoods, Croak the Boss, or whatever his name is, came to me with a delicate matter. I don't know what his problem with the local Lizardmen was, but that weirdo wanted to get rid of the local Shaman. When the Shaman does his shaman thing, Croak turns red from anger. So he asked me to make boots and a purse out of his skin. But there is the problem... My reputation doesn't allow me to do criminal things like this. I am a noble hero, defender of the oppressed, monster slayer, scourge of the undead, etc. Reputation is a strange thing, you know...
But if you kill the Shaman, your reputation will not suffer. You will also receive money which you deserve for eliminating the cold-blooded Lizardman. We'll share it evenly. Deal?

I don't like Lizardmen... They are savage and don't want to be civilized at all! It's not a problem... If they can't - we'll teach them, if they don't want to - we'll make them, if, of course, there is anyone left alive.

Did the shaman go on a journey to the land of spirits with a one-way ticket? Great!
If you want to make some money, come in. Don't be shy! We'll find something to do.
So, have you smoked the worm? Or did the worms almost smoke you out?
Right, here are the thorns. Wow, they are so sharp! Like needles. Here is your share and here is mine. Everything is fair!
Get a Translucent Fang, Dim Hydra's Scale, Blurred Eye and Shield of Deprecation. Bring them to George Siverian to receive your reward.

Oh, my sword is blunt... How much longer can I continue cutting monsters into pieces? As soon as one dies, there are three more taking its place. I tell you, this place is cursed! And don't listen to those midgets with hoods about their Master. Though they do pay for slain monsters in time and they are generous. So I don't complain.
Wait, don't you know anything about me? It can't be! Clever people even wrote about me in their books! Two swords, Wolf's Amulet, potions...
Well, if you don't remember me, I won't insist. My name is George. I come from Siveria. In some regions I am known as the White Beast... Maybe because of my hair color or maybe because I drink more booze than anyone! I like booze so much. Sometimes I even see animals... White animals!
The problem is that I have to pay for booze not with a story, but with a gold coin. So I work hard to save the world and satisfy myself. I kill beasts with sharp teeth, with wings or with two legs. I don't do it for free, of course. Aha, I see that you are interested.
Well, I have an errand for you. Bring me a Translucent Fang from a Spectral Warthog, a Solid Chitinous Plate from a Rocky Crawler, a Tarnished Hydra Scale from a Swamp Hydra and a Blurred Eye from a Searing Eye Elder. I will show them to the midgets with hoods and share my money with you. I'll share the money fairly.
I said "fair" but not "half"! Don't open your mouth too wide! Don't be afraid, I won't deceive you...

Oh, I remember this one sorceress... Dark hair, cherry lips... But what she did in bed! I miss girls so much. I see only beasts around. When I earn some more gold I will go to Eljune, to the Butterflies! I'll spend an entire month there!
Yes, give me the parts, I'll give you your reward! It's a fair deal!
Agree to help Sarbaz Samedi with his research.

Have you ever been to Avilon?
If you have, then you might remember Roxane de Doucer. Vampire Patriarch Armando de Doucer's daughter.
However, this is not about the tragic fate of this family. During the attack of the Darkblood Citadel on Avilon, Roxanne studied the blood of various creatures in an effort to learn how widely the vampire infection had spread. Perhaps you even had a chance to help her in this.
I got the results of this research. They were very interesting. A mysterious entity was discovered in the blood of each creature. To find it, we had to use magic and certain scientific methods.
Aha! I see you're interested! I wonder what you will say when you hear that this very essence, which I call "the fundamental principle of life", is exactly the same in mantes, toads, and squirrels! In everyone. In you and me. It's the same in everyone!
I plan to continue my research here, on the Isle of Revelation. Will you help us?

Thank you.
Maybe your assistance will help us to finish our research and learn the truth about the "First Element of Life".
Agree to help Sarbaz Samedi with his research.

However, this is not about the tragic fate of this family. During the attack of the Darkblood Citadel on Avilon, Roxanne studied the blood of various creatures in an effort to learn how widely the vampire infection had spread. Perhaps you even had a chance to help her in this.

I plan to continue my research here, on the Isle of Revelation. Will you help us?

Thank you.
Maybe your assistance will help us to finish our research and learn the truth about the "First Element of Life".
Get three Protoplasm samples from Hydras, Crawlers and Searing Eyes on the Isle of Revelation. Bring them to historian Sarbaz Samedi.

Let's start.
I've come to this island to examine the creatures inhabiting it. I have already studied beasts from Igsh, the Holy Land and some astral islands. My elven colleagues studied creatures from Kvatoh. Now it is my turn to explore this little island.
You should look for Hydras, Crawlers and Searing Eyes. I am almost certain that we will find the First Element in their samples! But the experiments must be precise and scholastic.
Remember, you don't have to take their blood samples. We have found a more suitable material for research. You can check if the sample contains the First Element straight away.
I am talking about Protoplasm. I need you to get it.
Bring me three Protoplasm samples from Hydras, Crawlers and Searing Eyes on the Isle of Revelation.
Did you get a Protoplasm Sample?

Well done!
I will examine these samples immediately...

Yes! Exactly. Analysis shows that Protoplasm taken from Hydras, Crawlers and Searing Eyes contains the First Element of Life.
Now we need to study Draconids. I must confess that experiments on sentient beings are the most difficult. Not everyone is willing to cooperate. On the Dragon Ring we failed to come to an agreement with the Draconids. So we didn't get their blood and protoplasm for analysis.
But we've made more progress here on the Isle of Revelation.
Draconid Priests agreed to give us drops of their blood. Yes, they were talking about blood. We tried to explain to them what protoplasm was, but they didn't understand. We'll have do things the old-fashioned way. Before you try to convince the Draconids, go and kill the Lizardmen. The Draconid Priests agreed to exchange blood drops for Lizardmen amulets.
Don't forget that you can't take all of the drops of blood at once. Priests will give you one drop for ten amulets. Now go. I'll be waiting for the samples!
It is an extraordinary case in terms of psychology... I cannot understand how Draconids treat lizards, their direct relatives. Do they hate or secretly worship them?..

Oh, you did it! Great.
I will immediately send the blood for analysis. Here in the middle of the swamp we will find nothing.

Interesting... While I was trading with some Wormfaces, in addition to June Charms they also asked whether I had any Draconid blood or hearts! Do they also study them?..
Finally, they agreed to take the Charms. However, I'm sure they'll find the way to get the blood and the hearts. I wish I knew what they needed them for...

Excellent!
I will analyze them right now...
I have received the results of the Draconid blood sample test from my colleagues. They also sent me this portable field laboratory. Now I can analyze samples right here. Why are they so generous? Because we are on the edge of the greatest scientific discovery ever since the invention of astral ships. It seems to me... Oh, I can't believe it, but the facts prove it... Together with my colleagues, I have found an element in the blood of every living being. It is the First Element of Life!
Wait for Sarbaz Samedi to develop a new theory.

It must be a mistake... My analysis reveals the First Element of Life but... this First Element differs from the First Element we found in the blood of other creatures!
What does this mean? Wormfaces are creatures from another world?!
But what about Draconids? Where are the test results, huh?
Oh, they are in my pocket... Here they are!
So...
Another surprise! The Draconids' First Element of Life is also different! They are also... Aliens.
I need to think... Wait a minute, usually I think very quickly.

I got it!
What do few people know about the Draconids? ... That they are creatures created by the Great Dragon of the Lizardmen.
What do we know about Wormfaces? This question is far more complicated... There is a theory that Junes somehow turned into them.
What do these two cases have in common?
We know... at least, we guess that there is a power which created everything. But what do we know about the powers that created other creatures with the common Essence of Life? Who created Hydras, Crawlers and Searing Eyes? Who created us?
We don't know. But we have made a step in the right direction.
The Great Power did it...
Was it the God and Creator?
Hmph, I never thought I would make such a conclusion!
Wait for Sarbaz Samedi to develop a new theory.

It must be a mistake... My analysis reveals the First Element of Life but... this First Element differs from the First Element we found in the blood of other creatures!
What does this mean? Wormfaces are creatures from another world?!
But what about Draconids? Where are the test results, huh?
Oh, they are in my pocket... Here they are!
So...
Another surprise! The Draconids' First Element of Life is also different! They are also... Aliens.
I need to think... Wait a minute, usually I think very quickly.

I got it!
What do few people know about the Draconids? ... That they are creatures created by the Great Dragon of the Lizardmen.
What do we know about Wormfaces? This question is far more complicated... There is a theory that Junes somehow turned into them.
What do these two cases have in common?
We know... at least, we guess that there is a power which created everything. But what do we know about the powers that created other creatures with the common Essence of Life? Who created Hydras, Crawlers and Searing Eyes? Who created us?
We don't know. But we have made a step in the right direction.
The Great Power did it...
Was it the God and Creator?
Hmph, I never thought I would make such a conclusion!
Inspect the three stone inscriptions and find a way to get into the wormface cave.

The intercom on the door is silent, completely ignoring your kicks, spits and curses. Is there any way to get into the cave from the outside? Blowing up the door is hardly an option.
However, the strange symbols on the intercom look vaguely familiar to you. Of course! You've already seen similar inscriptions and images on the stones and column remains in the old ruins.
One of the stones with the enigmatic symbols is located somewhere in the ruins to the west of the cave. Another old stone covered in mold and mud is somewhere amidst the Rusty Salt Marshes, so it won't be easy to find. Also, you remember hearing about some interesting bas-reliefs on the ruins beneath the waterfall. If you inspect all three stones, you will probably be able to pick the password to open the cave.
The massive stone door is sealed tight. Even if you blow it up, the passageway will surely get blocked up by debris. We'll have to find another option...
Now that you've found the right combination of symbols, the path into the wormface cave is open!
Search for and find the Strange Golem.

Greetings. I've heard about your progress in the search for Truth and I am impressed. You are good at solving puzzles, which your fate is rather generous to give to you. I'm willing to share one such puzzle with you.
A historian who visits the Citadel from time to time to boast about his success and to buy provisions told us a strange story. He swore that he had seen a June Golem, which are scattered in fragments all around the ruins of the city, moving! It was heading somewhere towards the south-east of the island!
I am not sure if it is true or if the historian was hallucinating. But if it is true, we should find that Golem and learn more about it.
Have you managed to find the Golem?

Obviously, the Golem was carrying a treasure chest. The way it ran out of charge and permanently shut down... Recently there was a strange outbreak of magic energy and the Golem was reactivated. It woke up and continued with the order it received hundreds of years ago. It is interesting...
Where was it carrying the treasure and why? This mystery will be difficult to solve...

This Golem is less damaged than the others. It looks old and broken but the dust under its feet has moved. It is not rooted to the ground like other Golems.
You should examine it more thoroughly...
There is a container in the Golem chest, but its lid is damaged. If you force it enough, you may be able to remove it!

Your intuition didn't fail! There is a small container in the Golem. An ornate strongbox was hidden inside.
You've earned this trophy!
Prove you're useful to be allowed to change your faction.

It's pretty hard to remain devoted, when you are on friendly terms with the gods, huh? But cheer up, there are a lot of heroes both in the Empire and in the League that only fight for themselves, and for nothing else, I assure you. So even if you're looking at the other side, put off your moral issues, I'm here to help you!
The road of a turncoat is long and winding! Will it ever bring one to anything good?
There you are. A different face, a different ID, a different life. Good luck with it all.
Complete Path of Trials in Tka-Rik's Cave at the Isle of Revelation. Bring Klavdia Kalugina 50 hearts of the elementals, 400 Battleground Emblems and a Watermark Paper.

Down to business. First, you will need a new set of documents. Easy to forge, provided you have real watermark paper. I have no idea how to steal some from the National Mint, but you will surely be able to get a few sheets from the missionary at Irdrich.
Second, a new face is a must - don't you dream of walking around Nezebgrad wearing an elven face! Novograd people won't be so happy to see an orc in their streets, either! Magic will help us. Bring me 400 Battleground Emblems to buy the necessary ingredients.
Third, the energy for the ritual is needed. Fifty hearts of the elementals will be just enough.
And finally, get yourself prepared for the transfer! Trials await! Meet me at Tka-Rik's cave.

It takes tons of time and effort, but it's worth it. If you give up, you're bound to spend the rest of your pathetic life in prison - either for treachery or for espionage, pick whichever you like best.
Nice. This will buy us another lot of components. Come back tomorrow, we are going to need even more!
Use the June Portal to travel to the Melting Isle. Touch the Frost Guardian to participate in the event.

Preparations for the Second Performance premiere are still being made. In the meantime, get yourself ready for it.
This June Portal will take you to a new location called the Melting Isle. For thousands of years this everfrost Allod kept the treasures of ancient Junes hidden. But recently the Global Warming has begun! Ancient ice is melting slowly, giving an opportunity to get hold of the treasures for those who are brave, fast, and smart. You can also try to recover them.
One more note to mention: a special rule works within the Isle - every man for himself. Although there are camps for both factions there, don't let them confuse you - they were established only to make sure that the contestants arrive to the Isle in one piece. Once you make you first step there, prepare to fight everyone on sight.
As soon as the Ancient Treasure appears on one of the thawed patches, Frost Guardians announce it to everyone on the Melting Isle. Only the one who manages to repel all enemy attacks and open the chest will receive the treasure.
You may depart to the Isle now. Upon arrival, touch the Frost Guardian to confirm that you accept the terms of the contest.

You touch the icy surface of the Guardian, and a cold wave passes through your body.
The Guardian has allowed you to participate in the battle for the Melting Isle treasures.

You touch the icy surface of the Guardian, and a cold wave passes through your body.
The Guardian has allowed you to participate in the battle for the Melting Isle treasures.

Participate in killing the Spirit of the Great June Hunter and the Spirit of the Great Dragon. Deliver the Potion of the Great Dragon to the Wormfaces' Leader. Give the Potion of the Great Hunter to the chief of the Draconids. Convince them to stop their ancient war and return to the Master's Voice in the Citadel.

I am the Keeper of Knowledge. I keep knowledge about everything that has happened, that will happen and that is happening now. When the time comes to use this knowledge, the Master speaks through me.
I know that you've earned the trust of our allies, the Draconids. They are young and therefore aggressive. You earned the trust of the Wormfaces, who don't forget ancient crimes.
The future is obscure. I clearly see only one thing: If Draconids and Wormfaces continue their war the world will be changed. It will be changed when it isn't ready to change. The change may destroy the world. We need to bring peace to these creatures. Do you want to help me? Then listen.
Many centuries ago, before Sarnaut was broken into pieces by a Cataclysm, the paths of the two Greats crossed. The Great Hunter met the Great Dragon. Just as fire cannot be mixed with water, these two greats couldn't control their nature. They started a useless fight. Why was the fight useless? Because their strength was equal and they knew it. Nobody could win. The only outcome was the death of both. And they died...
Powers summoned by the Greats were so huge that neither the Hunter nor Dragon could control the flow of energy, and it destroyed them. Their bodies were destroyed but not their souls.
Such irony of fate! The Great Dragon and Great Hunter turned into ghosts doomed to fight against each other to the end of their days.
I know that the Ghosts of the Greats are a good example of what happens when an old and stupid war takes full control over minds. Therefore, I'm asking you to go to the Granite Madness and find the spirits of the Greats. Set them free. Kill them to stop their eternal fight. Bring me their potions, their entities!
Take the Potion of the Great Hunter to the Draconids and take the potion of the Great Dragon to the Wormfaces. Mistakes of the past remain in the past... so do these ghost, who fought against each other for centuries and disappeared into the abyss. I am sure that when they learn about it they will start to wonder if they really needed this war...
An eternal fight between two great spirits... That's the essence of any war... useless and merciless...

I knew that you were strong enough to defeat the Great Ones. Now our eternal enemies will wonder whether their battles will end like this too.
Remember, you cannot live in the past. The past is forgotten, the future is closed for now, the present is here for you. Live in the present. Approach the future, stand firmly ahead of the past, then we'll defeat our common enemy Sarn really soon.
Go to Nezebgrad and tell Yasker that you are ready to take part in the ritual of Reincarnation.

So, reincarnation. Let me remind you how your Spark can be transferred to another body. Not a random body, but a specially prepared one.
With your Spark the new... ahem... the new you also receive some of your abilities. It will become another incarnation of you.
You can choose a new body of any race of the Empire. You may choose another class. You will keep two unique abilities of your class and a major part of your valuables; for example, items from the Boutique are available to both old and new you.
This is what Reincarnation is.
At any moment you may travel from one body to another. There is a specialist in Nezebgrad who can help you with that. Yasker, the leader of the Empire, knows everything about it. You should go and see him. One of the conditions of our agreement was that he could talk to every Imperial citizen willing to complete the ritual of Reincarnation in person.
Let's do it quickly. Go right now. Yasker is waiting for you.

Well... So you are too.
Well, it was predictable.
We were talking just recently with you about the meaning of the Revelation you received. Now our friends, or maybe enemies, are making a new move and offer you power and new possibilities.
Let me tell you what I think about it.

Here is what I tell you... If a riot can't be prevented you must lead it!
I mean figuratively. I'm not going to confront Nihaz and forbid you to go through the ritual of Reincarnation. You are to take this decision on your own.
I will just keep the situation under my control.
Anyway, you are offered to gain Power. Who would refuse it? I would accept it. I didn't reject to become Nezeb's follower. When I was drinking dragon's blood I also knew what I was doing.
Now you are to drink from the same cup. If I were you, I would never miss that chance.
Enough of fancy words. Let's go straight to business.
Reincarnation is only for the Chosen ones. Not everyone is honored to go through this ritual. I'll tell you more: not everyone should even know about such possibility. Got it? Everything connected with Reincarnation is a mystery.
You will find a specialist who may help you with the ritual here, on the first level of my tower. I will give her your name and she will be honest with you. Her name is Bisanu. She is a Tep's cultist. A former cultist. Indeed. She is a great specialist in Gorluxor machinery. We named her Sarang so that she wouldn't be very distinguished.
Go to the new scientist and ask her about Reincarnation. This information may help you to take the final decision.

So, everything is clear.
Put your signature here and here... With your blood.
Ha! I'm kidding!
Start the ritual, defeat yourself and tame your Spark. Complete the Ritual and talk to Klavdia Kalugina in the cave of Kirah.

Every our meeting is a new stage of your life. This stage is very important.
Let's start.
First of all, you are to defeat Fire Elementals in the cave. Not an unusual task, is it? I hope you remember how to use Eternal Fire. Use it to complete your task quickly. After you get rid of them approach the Dragon's Heart and start the Ritual.
The next stage is the most difficult. You must defeat the most dangerous enemy - yourself. You should do it several times. The meaning of the ritual is to take control over yourself and your Spark.
You will do it when it appears. You heart will be cold and your mind will be clear. It is the easiest part of the Ritual. Symbol of your victory.
As soon as you tame your Spark you are allowed to Reincarnate.

Have you ever dreamed to start everything over and to avoid all mistakes you did in the past?
Now you have this possibility.

Now it is done.
Congratulations. I'm sure you won't regret it. As for me, I never did.
Go to the secret cave of Kirah and talk to Klavdia Kalugina.

Now it is time for the Ritual.
No, we are not going to hold it in the center of Nezebgrad. Yasker wants to keep everything in secret, right?
We also need a Dragon's Heart. But where can we find it?
At the same place! In the secret cave of Kirah in the past.
Klavdia is waiting for you there to reward you with the gift of Reincarnation.
The keys and other stuff you may need to enter the cave I'm giving you right now. Go and find her. She's waiting.
I'll wait for our next meeting with you or with any of your Incarnations.
Every our meeting is a new stage of your life. This stage is very important.
Go to the secret cave of Kirah and talk to Klavdia Kalugina.

Now it is time for the Ritual.
No, we are not going to hold it in the center of Novograd. Aidenus wants to keep everything in secret, right?
We also need a Dragon's Heart. But where can we find it?
At the same place! In the secret cave of Kirah in the past.
Klavdia is waiting for you there to reward you with the gift of Reincarnation.
The keys and other stuff you may need to enter the cave I'm giving you right now. Go and find her. She's waiting.
I'll wait for our next meeting with you or with any of your Incarnations.
Every our meeting is a new stage of your life. This stage is very important.
Complete the trials in Tka-Rik's Cave and report your success to Klavdia Kalugina at the Overlord's Citadel.

The first exercise will harden your spirit.
I must be sure that the gift of Nihaz is to be given into the right hands. Fierce battles are ahead of us. I'd better get rid of the weak.
Go back to Tka-Rik's Cave. Now when Zak has fled and the deadly screen is gone, I started thoroughly investigating the legacy of the last June mage. I must admit the place is rather dangerous. There you will be offered to pass a number of Trials.
If you complete them it will mean we are not wasting our time.

By the way! You may complete the trial in Tka-Rik's Cave even after you complete your exercises to harden your Spark.
It will be... right.

Yes, I know that the exercise is finished. I was in that cave, remember?
Well done.
Go to the Kingdom of Elements, drink the poison and kill 20 monsters within 30 minutes. Then report back to Klavdia Kalugina at the Overlord's Citadel.

The second exercise will harden your Spark.
You will have to drink this poison in the Kingdom of Elements. Here you go.
Don't worry, you won't die. You'll become a debtor and will die in 30 minutes if you don't return your debt.
How are you going to return your debt? By killing monsters, of course! If you accomplish the task within the given time, your exercise will be complete and I'll discharge your debt. But if you are late you will have to return your debt by going to the Purgatory, and then start over again.
Is it clear?

I don't know who you are and I don't like to owe anybody.
Especially when it is a matter of life and death.

Everything is good. Debt is returned.
Good job.
Donate 3,000 Drops of Mirra to Klavdia Kalugina at the Overlord's Citadel.

The third exercise... Well... It's actually not an exercise.
Every work costs money. But work with Spark costs... Right! Drops of Mirra. Your third exercise is to bring me 3,000 Drops of Mirra every day.

Drops of Mirra have rather weak magic powers. It is a symbol. It is a symbol of faith.
But the price of this faith is rather high!

The third exercise is complete.
Well done.
Harden your Spark by completing exercises of Klavdia Kalugina to prepare yourself for the final ritual.

I will tell you how we can confront our enemy!
We can use his technology and make it better and more powerful. Nihaz, my benempt father, came to this conclusion.
Do you remember the story about the Dragon of Kirah? What do you think Nihaz is going to do with it? He is already immortal.
He wants this heart for you. Only we, apart from the Great Mages, will use the power of the Dragon's Blood in a different way. They wanted their bodies to be immortal, but we will harden our Spark.
Spark... is more reliable. A Great Mage can be killed, but Spark is much more difficult to destroy.
So, how are you going to harden your Spark?
You have to complete three exercises. It's pretty like your morning exercises. If you make it right, you will be ready for the ritual of Reincarnation.
What is it? It is an ability to transfer your soul to other bodies. When I was talking about enemy's technology I meant this.
It is a possibility to start a new life but with the experience from your previous life and with abilities which are not available to ordinary mortals.
Are you interested?
Let's start the training.

Come on! Don't be lazy!
Immortality is not easy to get!

Now I can tell that everything is ready.
Almost ready.
Go to Novograd and tell Aidenus that you are ready for Ritual of Reincarnation.

So, what are we almost ready for?
For reincarnation. I mean... For Reincarnation. Starting with a capital letter.
Let me remind you how your Spark can be transferred to another body. It is not a random body, but a specially prepared one.
With your Spark the new... ahem... the new you also receive some of your abilities. It will be you again! Another incarnation of you.
You can choose a new body of any race of the League. You may choose another class. You will keep two unique abilities of your class and a major part of your valuables; for example, items from the Boutique are available to both old and new you.
This is what Reincarnation is.
In any moment you may travel from one body to another. There is also a specialist in Novograd who can help you. Aidenus, the Great Mage of the League, knows everything about it. You should go and see him. One of the conditions of our agreement was that he could talk to every citizen of the League willing to complete the ritual of Reincarnation in person.
Let's do it quickly. Go right now. Aidenus is waiting for you.

I've been expecting you.
Recently we talked about the Revelation. Even then I had known that soon you would be offered new possibilities. This Power is much like Tensess' Gift.
I am ready to talk. Now listen!
Ask Mara de Doucer about Reincarnation.

It is always better to regret something you did than something you missed.
I'm not going to persuade you from completing the Reincarnation Ritual. I passed through a similar ritual in the Conclave of the Great Mages. You are the one to make the decision.
But if you ask me if I regret what was done... Am I ready to go back to the Past and order myself not to drink the Dragon's Blood?
No! I have no regrets. It was my chance to gain power and I used it. Now you have such chance. It's your call.
But I want to warn you.
Reincarnation is only for the Chosen ones. The unworthy won't complete the ritual. In order not to confuse minds and not to confront the Church of Light it was decided to keep information about Reincarnation in secret.
The specialist who will help you with the ritual is in Novograd in Elven District. Her name is Mara de Doucer. As far as I know, she is a great specialist in Gorluxor's machinery.
Go find her and ask about Reincarnation. Only then you should make your decision.

You have no questions, do you? Good.
Don't be a chicken. Reincarnation is not painful. Some people even like it, ha ha!
Receive Tka-Rik Revelation and find your way to Reincarnation. Report to Klavdia Kalugina.

I really appreciate how you are able to appear in the right place on the right time. I've got a question to you. How about a little trip to a far-away allod to find out how Sarnaut appeared? You will see the whole world from quite a new angel. That will be a real Revelation for you.

Ah, I see that familiar sparkle in your eyes. You are not going there on vacation. I have an important mission for you. It's about so called ritual of Reincarnation. You're asking, what it is? One say, it's a great gift. Others say, it's a powerful weapon. Technically speaking, Reincarnation is a transfer of your Spark into a different body, you may also describe it as immortality, but safer, than the gift of Tensess. By the way, you've already come across this phenomenon. Remember Gorluxor with his countless heads? I have no idea, how he found out about the Reincarnation rite, but it doesn't matter, anyway. Committee's agents have discovered a new source of information.

You are going to the Isle of Revelation. Nihaz and his servants are calling the shots there. You will find the Revelation of Tka-Rik and prepare for the Reincarnation rite - you're doubtlessly worthy of it. Klavdia Kalugina will help you with that. You will find her in Master's Citadel on the Isle of Revelation.

Good luck!
So, you want to know the Revelation. Aren't you scared? Those who discovered it before, broke down and cried. Some of them even committed suicide!

Now you know the truth. Revelation of Tka-Rik, or Nihaz, or your own - it's up to you to decide. Are you feeling alright? You are very pale.

You'll be okay. We have another thing to take care of. Have you ever heard about the Reincarnation? Yes, you have? I guess Yasker sent you here to find out about it, am I right?
Receive Tka-Rik Revelation and find your way to Reincarnation. Report to Klavdia Kalugina.

I really appreciate how you are able to appear in the right place on the right time. I've got a question to you. How about a little trip to a far-away allod to find out how Sarnaut appeared? You will see the whole world from quite a new angel. That will be a real Revelation for you.

One say, it's a great gift. Others say, it's a powerful weapon. By the way, you've already come across this phenomenon. Remember Gorluxor with his countless heads? I have no idea, how he found out about the Reincarnation rite, but it doesn't matter, anyway. Committee's agents have discovered a new source of information.

You are going to the Isle of Revelation. Nihaz and his servants are calling the shots there. You will find the Revelation of Tka-Rik and prepare for the Reincarnation rite - you're doubtlessly worthy of it. Klavdia Kalugina will help you with that. You will find her in Master's Citadel on the Isle of Revelation.

Best of luck in your heroic deeds!
So, you want to know the Revelation. Aren't you scared? Those who discovered it before, broke down and cried. Some of them even committed suicide!

Now you know the truth. Revelation of Tka-Rik, or Nihaz, or your own - it's up to you to decide. Are you feeling alright? You are very pale.

You'll be okay. We have another thing to take care of. Have you ever heard about the Reincarnation? Yes, you have? I guess Aidenus sent you here to find out about it, am I right?

Hey, I'm not old! I am still young! Youth is not measured in years. It is all about your soul!
Well, let's think we greeted each other. How are you doing?
I'm not doing great.
Why? Because I'm concerned about the fate of the world.
Do you want to discuss it?

Do you remember the story with three Gorluxor's heads? Remember those strange machines in Gorluxor's Tower, or you haven't been there yet?
Anyway, explanation is always useful.
Tensess' Gift makes it possible for your Spark, which is the basis of your life, to return into your body after death. It makes resurrection possible and that is why Tensess became a Saint.
But what if there is no body? What if it was torn apart or at least decapitated?
Spark has no place to come back. Say "Hi" to death!
But Gorluxor resurrected. His body had no head but he resurrected.
Those machines made it possible. They created new bodies identical to the original! That's how the rebellious mage broke the restrictions of the Tensess' Gift.
Of course, Sarn was involved, as also was Tep. Demon cultists are trying to contact him. But it is not important right now.
The main question is what our counter-action will be.

Lizardmen are our fathers. And our enemy! We fight lizard, but lizards are many. We need less lizard!
You help us! Find lizard village. Take lizard eggs. Five handfuls of eggs!
Me help you! Me reward you! Me reward you tasty! You agree?

You friend! You do good.
You take reward!

So, you've earned our respect? Good for you...
We need materials for further research. To be more precise, we need lymph extract from the Crawlers. If you bring us these samples you will earn our respect.
The task is difficult because we need these samples taken from a live Crawler, because before death, a Crawler's glands produce a lot of hormones and ferments, which may spoil experiment results.
In the Container under the Talk-back Device you will find a special device which can be used to paralyze a Crawler. When it is paralyzed you must take a sample from under its left neck plate. The analyzer will automatically store the sample in a special container, so you don't have to worry about dealing with 15 fragile bottles with solutions in as was the case with older technology. Be very careful! If you wake the Crawler you are in trouble!
Use the paralyzer, then the analyzer. Don't confuse them!

Oh, here are the tissue samples. Great. We are grateful to you. Maybe... Somewhere deep in our souls. Somewhere very very deep...
Well, take your sign. Maybe we'll need more samples. Come from time to time to check if we have any new errands.

The chest looks old. The wood is darkened with time, its corners are covered with web and it is submerged an inch into the ground under its own weight. It seems to be here for several decades.
But there are fresh scratches on the latches and the hinges are dabbled with oil. Somebody must have opened it recently. Was anything taken from the chest or put inside?
As you have spent several minutes trying to open the latches of the chest you kick its rotten top with your leg and open it!

Well-well! A cultist decided to hide his belongings in this chest assuming that no one will bother searching such a humble box. That was his huge mistake.
All good things will come to he who seeks. And if he seeks well...
Find the treasures hidden by the cultists somewhere on the Twilight Isle.

Text on the surface of the Astralophone says:
Attention! All adventurers fighting against cultists on the Twilight Isle!
Ruins of the ancient city hide a lot of valuables such as gold, gems and artifacts. Cultists might have discovered major part of them and might have hidden the loot somewhere in their camps.
The less gold the cultists have, the less people they will bribe. Adventurers! Don't miss your chance to find chests, boxes and other hidden treasures. Don't be shy to take the loot. All loot is tax free and belongs to the one who found it.

A new message on the surface of Astralophone is shimmering with dim light:
Congratulations to all adventurers who found the treasure. The less money cultists have, the less their influence is. Don't forget to check all hiding spots! You may discover another treasure and rob the Cult.
Go to Draconid Island and talk to Chief Urgash about trust of Draconids.

I've heard about your success that you reached in relationship with our scaly allies. Winning the trust of such aggressive and suspicious creatures was not easy and I'm glad that you broke the wall of enmity.
I rely on Draconids and hope they will be a big help in the coming battle against Sarn. They are strong, quick and numerous. They have strong hate for Demons!
I believe you should go to their Chief and find out if they really accept you as their brethren and if they are ready to join us in the battle against our common enemy. Go and don't waste our time. If they really respect you as deeply as I was told then you may lead their army in the upcoming battle!

You are not called meatbag anymore! You are now brother-brother!
You take necklace. You kill enemy, take tooth, add to necklace! Then everyone knows you are great hunter!
Talk to the representative of the Overmind of the Wormfaces via Intercom and get the reward.

Wormfaces... What do we know about them? They are an ancient race, reserved and inhospitable. Also they are wise, reasonable and cruel. I am surprised at your success while others, like the Elven historian, failed this mission.
The fact that the Wormfaces trusted you a piece of their ancient knowledge is a huge step forward. They have been accumulating their knowledge about the world for thousands of years. Maybe the only thing we lack to understand the Truth is knowledge. They may help you to receive the Revelation and defeat Sarn.
Now go to the cave. One of the leaders of the Wormfaces, those who call themselves "The Overmind" sent us a message that he wants to see you. I believe the Wormfaces want to reward you!
Hurry up. I think that the reward will be very unusual.
Everything in the world has its price, my friend. Only knowledge is priceless! We will never trust someone who doesn't want to work hard to earn the knowledge and looks for ready answers.

We, the Overmind, hope that you as a distinguished member of your tribe will see the true value of our gift.
Now go. You made us face a tough choice. We are having new issues we have to think about.
Remember, you are our friend now. We are always happy to help someone who sincerely searches knowledge!
Activate the Resonator at the Demonic Portal when cultists open it with their spells. Report to Astralophone at the Overlord's Stronghold.

The new order received via Astralophone says:
Urgent message to all armies of the Overlords and their allies!
Cultists found the way to transport reinforcements to the Twilight Isle through Demonic Portals. If we don't stop them, the whole campaign to capture the Twilight Isle may be at risk.
Seeker of Truth, you are entrusted with an important mission. There are Demonic Portals in the ruins on the Isle. Cultists need to keep them open to deliver reinforcements. If you interrupt the process and use the Resonator while cultists keep the portal open, it will collapse and everything inside it will be turned to dust.
The task is complicated because the field of an active portal quickly drains life from anyone who is not wearing special protection. You have a couple of seconds to approach the portal and activate the Resonator.
Surface of the Astralophone is dark. There are no new messages.

The new message confirms the success of the operation:
Great job! At least 50 demons passing through the portal at the moment of explosion turned into dust.
Unfortunately, we cannot block all portals. But if you keep on destroying their portals sooner or later they will rout and the Cult will be destroyed.
Confirm that you are ready to prove your friendship to Draconid.

Surface of the Astralophone flashes brightly and you hear a very familiar voice in your head. It is your Draconid friend:
Friend and brother! I'm so glad talk to you. I do not see you but I hear you. You hear me?
I'm so glad!
Chief say Fire Father speak. I'm speaking with you! My friend. I know debt. Do you know debt?
You don't know? Friendship is debt! Always pay back. Die but pay back!
I die for you! You are brother and friend! Do you agree?

Draconid sounds happy:
I knew you understood me! I'm so happy... Fire Father is happy! It is important! It is more important than me, than you, than everything. Fire Father is happy and we are all happy! The whole world is happy!
Confirm that you are ready to prove your friendship to Draconid.

Friend and brother! I'm so glad talk to you. I do not see you but I hear you. You hear me?
I'm so glad!
Chief say Fire Father speak. I'm speaking with you! My friend. I know debt. Do you know debt?
You don't know? Friendship is debt! Always pay back. Die but pay back!
I die for you! You are brother and friend! Do you agree?

Draconid sounds happy:
I knew you understood me! I'm so happy... Fire Father is happy! It is important! It is more important than me, than you, than everything. Fire Father is happy and we are all happy! The whole world is happy!
Use Kaboomer to destroy five Demonic Portals in different parts of the Twilight Isle and report your success via Astralophone in the Overlord's Stronghold.

Voice of Urgash the Draconids Chief reaches through noises in the Astralophone:
"Brother-brother! I talk. Strange thing bring my words, yes? Good.
We talk to great! Great talk wise things.
Great says demon not walk our land. Demon build por... port... portals! Demons not build. Their friend build. Cultists build. Portals everywhere! Worm-on-faces walk!
Me ask you. Take Kaboomer from Worm-on-faces. You seek portal. Find. You fire Kaboomer and run. Kaboomer bang, portal bang. We are happy-happy! We call you great warrior!
You hear the voice of Urgash full of hope: "Brother-brother. I'll wait. We are tough. We'll wait your hand bang a portal."

You hear happy voice of Urgash in your head:
Brother-brother! You great warrior! You boom! Portal bang!
Great is pleased.
Now Great speaks with you. You listen. Great is clever! Great knows all.
Open the vial with dragon blood in the location marked on the map of the Astral Coast and lure the demons. Then wait for the dragons to arrive and help them to defeat the demons.

Suddenly Urgash's voice disappears and you hear another mighty voice. It seems to come out of everywhere and it makes the land tremble:
Mortal! I am Soliskar the Wise, the Great Dragon. Once we met before, in the place which you, mortals, call the Dragon Ring. I believed in you back then. You... You are different from other mortals. You have something which distinguishes you among others. The errand I have for you I cannot entrust to anyone else.
You will get a vial with drops of my blood. After what happened to you on Kirah you know its priceless. Don't waste it!
I am asking you to open the vial with my blood in three locations on the southern coast in a place which you, mortals, call the Twilight Isle. Demons smell dragon's blood thousands wingbeats away. Hundreds of them will follow the smell. You won't defeat them alone. Give me a signal. Fire a red rocket and I will send my sons to help you. Their breath will turn astral beasts into ashes!
I hope you will succeed. Go now! We don't have much time. Follow my instructions! My blood is too precious to be wasted.

I see my blood was not wasted. Dozens of demons were killed with fangs and claws of my children! They are enraged! That was our goal.
You see, all these errands: assassination of their leaders, explosion of portals and total extermination of the demonic scum lured by the smell of my blood had only one goal - to lure out of the depth of Astral the one called Ar'Kanim, the leader of octulhus and one of the strongest beasts of Sarn. Today I will put the end to his useless life myself!
Kill demon minions approaching the coast while Soliskar defeats Ar'Kanim.

Listen to me carefully, mortal. Ar'Kanim is on his way here from the depth of Astral. We have no time to argue.
Soon I will engage into battle against one of the strongest beasts of our enemy. I'm stronger than him, but countless demons will fight on his side. This is where I need your help.
When Ar'Kanim start losing his strength, he will summon demon minions to help him. If any of them reaches the coast where the fight takes place, Ar'Kanim will consume its power and heal his wounds.
Mortal! Do not let demon minions approach the coast! Kill them until I defeat Ar'Kanim. Your name will remain in the history of this world.
When Ar'Kanim is dead, you will meet another creature who helps us in this battle, a Wormface. Talk to him to receive further instructions.
The time has come! Let's start the battle!
Ar'Kanim is dead... It means my time has come...

Are you surprised that we cooperate with dragons?
Believe me, even sworn enemies may unite their efforts to defeat the power hostile to them both!
Kill Wormface Fanatic and combine his blood with Ar'Kanim's blood. Bring the item you receive to Soliskar the Wise.

Listen to me carefully!
It doesn't matter who I am. My name gives you nothing as my life ends in several minutes. That's right. My death will save my nation.
Ar'Kanim is not just the leader of octulhus. His blood contains supreme powers given by Sarn. Dragons want to receive these powers.
My blood will start the reaction. I've been preparing myself for this day. My body suffered hundreds of magic effects, elixirs, potions and powders. Pure concentrated magic flows in my veins! The time has come to spill it.
I am telling you this to calm you down. Your strike must be precise. The stakes are too high. Don't let my death be meaningless!
Kill me and combine my blood with Ar'Kanim's blood.
Bring the mixture to Soliskar. It's our gift to dragons for their help. A part of the deal.
This deal must not be broken!

Here it is... Ingot of Astral Iron... Now we the powers of the Seal belong to us! We have completed our part of the deal. The Great One will be pleased...
I know what you want, mortal. Fragment of the Crystal Armor, your next step to the Revelation. You will receive it from the Astralophone at the Citadel of your Master. Maybe then you'll understand what just happened!
Keep it in secret. Nobody should know about this ingot. Let everyone think that you, the great hero, defeated Ar'Kanim. I will remain in shadows.
Farewell, mortal! I don't think we'll ever meet again.
Learn what the Father of Fire told your Draconid Friend.

Surface of the Astralophone flashes and you hear the familiar voice of your Draconid Friend:
Friend and brother! You my brother! The Father of Fire told so! You are brother to all! You helped!
What you want? You want I kill your relatives? You be free like fire! No debts! We often do so...
Oohh! The Father of Fire wants to tell me something! Wait!
One moment!

Surface of the Astralophone flashes again and you hear the whisper of your Draconid friend:
The Father of Fire has chosen the reward for you... He gave you this shard. He told it was important for you... Mine is happy, very happy!
Astralophone flashes, and a Fragment appears with a note saying: "Be more careful"!
Astralophone is a device designed to transmit messages and small items through the Astral. Astralophone network connects Overlord's Stronghold and remote outposts of his servants.
